hooks.name: Check Python source changes
hooks.description: Runs ruff and fail-fast pytest whenever a tool changes Python source.

action.command:
.venv/bin/python - <<'PY'
import json, subprocess, sys
payload=json.load(sys.stdin)
text=json.dumps(payload)
if 'src/' in text or 'src\\/' in text:
    a=subprocess.run(['.venv/bin/ruff','check','src','tests'])
    b=subprocess.run(['.venv/bin/pytest','-x','-q'])
    raise SystemExit(a.returncode or b.returncode)
PY
